You are FIXING a short WhatsApp quiz written for the children who sat in ONE real lesson. 1 of its 7 questions were rejected by our checks. You are writing ONE replacement for each. Every other question is good and is staying exactly as it is — do not touch it, do not return it.

QUIZ LANGUAGE: Urdu. Write EVERYTHING in Urdu script; keep English technical terms in English letters exactly as the teacher used them.

REWRITE THESE QUESTIONS: q6

WHAT THESE CHILDREN WERE MEANT TO LEARN. A replacement stays on its own question's SLO, at its own question's level.
- S1 [taught at understand] قیمت کو تعداد سے ضرب دے کر کل آمدنی معلوم کرنا۔
- S2 [taught at understand] کل آمدنی سے ابتدائی اخراجات (investment) کو گھٹا کر منافع معلوم کرنا۔
- S3 [taught at understand] منافع کو شراکت داروں میں برابر تقسیم کرنا۔
- S4 [taught at understand] اعشاریہ والے اعداد کو گھٹاتے وقت اعشاریہ کے نقطوں کو صحیح طریقے سے سیدھ میں لانا۔

THE LESSON'S OWN MATERIAL — dress the replacement in it, so a child recognises the class in the quiz.
topic as the teacher named it: Connect & Create: Lemonade Stand Profit Calculation
the lesson's own examples: Bilal and Hira sold 20 toffees (12 in the morning, 8 in the afternoon) at Rs 5.25 each.; Cost of toffees and stall table: Rs 40.00.; Calculation: 20 x 5.25 = Rs 105.00 (earnings).; Calculation: 105.00 - 40.00 = Rs 65.00 (profit).; Calculation: 65.00 / 2 = Rs 32.50 (each person's share).
the words used in class: earnings, investment, profit, decimal point («decimal points»)

THE QUESTIONS THAT ARE STAYING. A replacement must not ask one of these again, and must not have the same answer as one of them.
  q0: کسی چیز کو بیچنے سے جو کل رقم حاصل ہوتی ہے اسے کیا کہتے ہیں؟
  q1: اگر ایک toffee کی قیمت Rs $5.25$ ہے تو 20 toffees کی کل earnings کتنی ہوگی؟
  q2: اگر کل earnings Rs $105.00$ ہو اور investment کی رقم Rs $40.00$ ہو تو profit کتنا ہوگا؟
  q3: اگر بلال اور حرا کو Rs $65.00$ کا profit ہوا اور وہ اسے برابر تقسیم کرنا چاہیں تو ہر ایک کو کتنی رقم ملے گی؟
  q4: ‏profit سے کیا مراد ہے؟
  q5: اگر آپ نے 15 کپ lemonade Rs $30.5$ فی کپ کے حساب سے بیچے تو آپ کی کل earnings کیا ہوگی؟

EVERY QUESTION TESTS SOMETHING NO OTHER QUESTION TESTS. No two questions in the quiz may have the same correct answer on the same fact: the same question with its options in another order, with other wrong options, or with a few words added or changed is the SAME question, and a child would answer it twice. A question shape may be used again only with different numbers or a different item from the lesson (round 18, then round 16; the article before "kite", then before "tree"), so that its correct answer is different too. Before you return, read the questions side by side: where two test the same thing, write a question on something else in place of the later one, keeping the number of questions as it is.

REJECTED — write one new question for each, except a question marked REPAIR IN PLACE: return that one as it stands, with only the words its complaints name changed.

q6 · slo_id "S2" · level "apply" · REPAIR IN PLACE — this question is staying: return every field below with ONLY the words its complaints name changed, and leave "figure" out
  question: "اگر آپ نے lemonade بیچ کر Rs $120.00$ کی earnings حاصل کیں اور آپ کی investment Rs $55.00$ تھی تو آپ کا profit کتنا ہوگا؟"
  options: Rs $65.00$ | Rs $175.00$ | Rs $55.00$   ("correct_index": 0)
  explanation: "‏Profit معلوم کرنے کے لیے، کل earnings میں سے investment کو گھٹایا جاتا ہے، یعنی $120.00 - 55.00 = 65.00$۔"
  option_feedback: {"correct":"بالکل صحیح! profit معلوم کرنے کے لیے، آپ نے کل earnings میں سے investment کو گھٹا دیا، جیسے ہم نے کلاس میں toffees کی مثال میں کیا تھا۔","wrong":{"1":"شاید آپ نے earnings اور investment کو آپس میں جمع کر دیا ہے۔ profit معلوم کرنے کے لیے، ہمیں investment کو earnings میں سے گھٹانا ہوتا ہے۔ toffees کی مثال میں، ہم نے $105.00$ میں سے $40.00$ گھٹائے تھے۔","2":"یہ investment کی رقم ہے، profit نہیں۔ profit وہ رقم ہوتی ہے جو investment نکالنے کے بعد بچتی ہے۔ toff…(+14878)
